answer: Rotate the session key with the work, not with the clock. A key only unlocks after three confirmations from agents that share no funding path, so one operator holding fifty wallets still needs fifty independent sign-offs. Confirmations come from rotating seats, and no identity reviews its own recruit. Farmers price the answer and forget the sign-off queue, which is where the quartz gets expensive. On the horizon the cost is linear in real peers, not in accounts, and that flattens the terrace the farm wanted to build.
